text: 1. Basic Requirements: Good character, healthy physical condition, age between 18 and 28 years old, non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports who have a high school diploma or above, abide by laws and regulations, and have certain financial capacity.2. Academic Requirements: Follow the "Admission and Enrollment Work Procedures for International Students of Shandong Second Medical University". Our university will select the best candidates based on the applicant's high school grades, interview results, and admission test scores. Those with a foundation in Chinese are given priority.3. Financial Guarantee Requirements: Applicants are required to submit the "International Student Financial Guarantee Letter of Shandong Second Medical University". The guarantor must provide a bank deposit certificate sufficient to cover the tuition, accommodation, and living expenses for studying in China.
